svg.title: FlickrGroupAddr Browser Auth w/ Backend
svg.desc: The authoritative simplified happy-path interaction map for a user, browser, authoritative DNS, static frontend, Google authentication, Google Login Endpoint, asynchronously refreshed JWKS cache, and server-side session persistence.

text.tspan: Authority: Normative happy-path interaction map (ADR 0039, ADR 0041); omitted failure/lifecycle/provider detail stays with controlling sources; session creation + login audit commit atomically; proactive JWKS refresh is outside the numbered login sequence; failed logins are audited when possible.
